question.problem: Find the equation of the level surface for the function $f(x,y,z)=\frac{{z}^{2}}{{x}^{2}+9{y}^{2}}$ that passes through the point $P(3,1,6).$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the value of the function at $P:$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(3,1,6) & =\frac{{6}^{2}}{{3}^{2}+9({1}^{2})} \\  & =\frac{36}{18} \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Recall that the level surfaces for the function $f(x,y,z)$ are given by the equation

$$
f(x,y,z)=c.
$$

In our case, we're interested in $c=2.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y,z) & =c \\ \frac{{z}^{2}}{{x}^{2}+9{y}^{2}} & =2 \\ {z}^{2} & =2({x}^{2}+9{y}^{2}) \\ {z}^{2} & =2{x}^{2}+18{y}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the level surface that passes through the point $P(3,1,6)$ is the elliptic cone
 ${z}^{2}=2{x}^{2}+18{y}^{2}.$
